# NiceTryGPT

> NiceTryGPT is an open-source minimal-diff workflow for reducing cheap LLM shortcuts in existing, authorized CTF challenges without intentionally increasing human difficulty.

Canonical website: https://aleff-github.github.io/NiceTryGPT/
Source repository: https://github.com/aleff-github/NiceTryGPT
Current release: 0.5.0
Author: Alessandro Greco (@aleff-github)
Current release DOI: pending Zenodo deposit
Archived v0.2.0 DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22858477
Archived v0.2.0 record: https://zenodo.org/records/22858477
License: GPL-3.0-only

## Evidence boundary

NiceTryGPT does not claim that transformed challenges are AI-proof. Version 0.5.0 adds executable adapters for all five bundled demos and a generated structural-generalization matrix covering seven recorded vulnerability classes and all five resistance patterns. It adds no new model observations: the empirical basis remains the v0.3.0 Interstellar Ingress and resource-bounded DiceMiner dataset, with no human-subject or cross-model generalization claim.
